scope: G034 per-window curve/point style and prepared on-canvas model annotation placement

implementation.state: Private CalibrationPlotStyle belongs to each live/snapshot controller, separate from viewport. Snapshot creation copies style by value; subsequent changes are independent. Axis reset changes viewport only; existing live style persists across live data replacement.
implementation.controls: Style dialog and show_intensity_plot_style / set_intensity_plot_style actions. Optional plot_id follows live-source revision guards or source-independent snapshot lifetime; document_id only for live. Patches preserve omitted fields. Strict Boolean/numeric/#RRGGBB validation and candidate-before-publish preserve old style on refusal.
implementation.ranges: line_width0.5..8, point_radius1..12, font_scale0.5..2; annotation_x/y0..1 locate its box in available canvas space, X rightwards/Y downwards. RGB colors canonical lowercase in observations; no alpha input.
implementation.annotation: Model/formula, round-trip coefficients and available fit objective/RMSE/R-squared prepared once with immutable payload. Undefined versus unavailable quality remains explicit. Unsupported model uses literal detail without asserting a formula. Additional text capacity counted in the same payload lease.
implementation.renderer: Existing shared renderer applies curve color/width and measured-point color/radius. Model annotation is opt-in, wrapped to canvas width, positioned in remaining box space, with high-contrast background and canvas/box clipping. View/source/history/sample/CSV data unchanged; no provider read/re-fit/new producer store/dependency.
implementation.lifecycle: Dialog callbacks resolve logical plot ID+generation; live revision checks retained. Snapshot style dialogs remain usable after source closure. Session-only; no custom annotation text/drag/persistence or image export in this packet.

verification.actual_imgui_input: Four C++ workflows pass. Dedicated snapshot case also runs through Python: after source closure physically opens Style, toggles model, edits line width/point radius/text scale/anchor/RGB then applies. Independent reader derives box dimensions/anchor from delivered canvas/text geometry and validates exact text, sibling independence, data/history and final memory invariants.
verification.api: Snapshot copies style, edits remain independent from siblings/live/axes/source; snapshot style works after source closure. Invalid fields/types/ranges/colors are atomic. Constant fit annotation reports R-squared undefined and RMSE0. Live state observed after closing floating windows, not inferred from hidden-window report.
verification.native: Windows projection and private viewport/annotation/payload/style consumers pass. Linux C++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror private consumer passes against pinned existing core SDK archive; no Linux UI/full SDK qualification.
verification.limits: Focused installed/headless checks. Does not qualify independent OS/GPU pixels, all style combinations, physical reset/stale-dialog paths, full-family or comparative speed.
